name: enhancephoto-mcp
description: Local MCP server for image metadata inspection, print DPI sizing, quality diagnostics, pixel-art integer upscaling, and web export.

tools.name: inspect_image
tools.description: Reads dimensions, megapixels, aspect ratio, format, DPI, color space, alpha channel, file size, and EXIF camera metadata.

tools.name: calculate_print_size
tools.description: Computes target pixel size, effective DPI, required upscale factor, and aspect-ratio crop warnings for print presets or custom sizes.

tools.name: diagnose_image_quality
tools.description: Measures edge sharpness, resolution adequacy, JPEG compression density, exposure clipping, and pixel-art characteristics.

tools.name: upscale_pixel_art
tools.description: Losslessly upscales sprites and pixel art by an integer factor (2x-8x) using nearest-neighbor interpolation.

tools.name: prepare_for_web
tools.description: Resizes without enlargement, strips EXIF metadata by default, and exports to WebP, AVIF, JPEG, or PNG.
